$comment: Microsoft Marketplace SaaS offer configuration. Plan ids are the ids entered for each plan in Partner Center (Plan overview > Plan ID) and map onto the purchasable plans in data/plans.json. Dimension ids are the metered billing dimensions declared on each plan; each one counts real usage_events rows for the linked account. Read by api/_lib/microsoft-marketplace.js.
included_comment: Quantity of each metered dimension included in one monthly billing period of each Partner Center plan, entered on the plan as the dimension's included quantity. Derived from data/plans.json: mcp_tool_calls = limits.mcp_calls_per_day x billing_period_days, agent_messages = limits.free_model_messages_per_day x billing_period_days. tests/microsoft-billing.test.js fails if the two drift. Shown on /dashboard/billing as the meter's ceiling.
